MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "If Corazon is Santana's album, its guitar focus makes it a natural follow-up to my interest in Clapton and Hendrix.",
    "The later Beatles connect with my classic-rock interests, while Norah Jones offers a relaxed, soulful connection to Memphis, even though neither is my first choice today."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Big Hits of the 80's offers a broad era connection without a clear link to the blues and roots sounds I want.",
    "Greatest Hits and Definitive Collection leave the artist unknown, so I cannot establish a musical connection strong enough to choose them.",
    "Wallflower and Lb - Kill The Lights do not give me enough evidence of the guitar-focused sound I am looking for."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in classic rock seems to have been stretched into a general interest in older hits and compilations, which does not explain what I enjoy about those albums.",
    "Blown Away seems to have been taken as a broad invitation to recommend country, although that connection alone is not enough for me to choose another album today."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The connection between Old Sock and People, Hell & Angels matters because expressive guitar playing is a stronger draw for me right now than a shared era.",
    "An artist or identifiable album gives me a reason to explore; vague collection titles do not, especially when I am only likely to choose one strong match.",
    "Something can fit my broader taste, like the Beatles or Patsy Cline, without being what I want to listen to next."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my classic-rock and roots interests but give too little weight to my current preference for a clearly identifiable, guitar-focused album."
}
